name: Weather forecast
status: Connected · published to Atlas and verified on production
description: Four daily periods at representative interior points. Model grid output; not a measured district average. Model issue time is not supplied by this endpoint.
attribution: Weather data by Open-Meteo · CC BY 4.0
authentication: Free non-commercial endpoint; commercial customer API key supported in ETL only
license: CC BY 4.0 data; API access terms apply separately
commercial_permission: Free endpoint excludes commercial use; customer subscription required
redistribution_permission: Attribution required; source data licence applies
spatial_resolution: Provider model grid; returned grid coordinate retained
latency: Model updates vary; issue time unavailable in response
fallback: Retain last complete published snapshot; disclose age and failed runs

name: Reservoirs & dams
status: Daily storage product accepted · awaiting first Atlas publication
description: 35 large-dam daily storage reports. RID coordinates matched to canonical geography. Report date is supplied; exact observation time is unknown. Flow quantities remain outside the accepted product until their accumulation window is verified.
attribution: Royal Irrigation Department · Government Open Data / DGA Open Government License
authentication: Documented public GET succeeded without credentials; other products unverified
license: RID dataset catalogued as Open Data Common; DGA Open Government License terms and attribution retained
commercial_permission: DGA open-data terms permit reuse; project use is non-commercial
redistribution_permission: Attribution and original data meaning must be retained; provider exceptions apply
request_quota: Not published; one scheduled documented GET per day, with bounded failure retries
spatial_coverage: 35 verified large-dam IDs; coordinates published by the RID map
spatial_resolution: Dam location point; not reservoir extent or downstream influence
temporal_resolution: Daily report date only; no fabricated observation instant
units_crs: million m³; percent of normal storage capacity (may exceed 100%); RID published latitude/longitude
latency: Provider publication time is not specified; report date and retrieval time shown independently
fallback: Retain last complete 35-dam published generation; disclose age and failure

name: Agency warnings & radar
description: Official products retain agency wording, issuance, expiry and attribution. No warning absence is inferred from a missing connection.
authentication: Official portal offers registration; no authenticated product sample configured

name: River & rain gauges
description: Official exchange standards describe agency-specific endpoints and tokens, rather than one live nationwide entitlement. Authorized endpoint, station datum, coverage and sample acceptance remain pending.
authentication: Agency-specific token/access arrangement required; not configured

name: Satellite flood observations
description: Official flood catalog directs users to register for an API key and leaves its dataset license unspecified. Product permission and an acquisition-time sample are required before enabling satellite-observed flood extents.
authentication: Registered user-owned gateway key required; not configured
license: Official flood catalog: License not specified; reuse permission pending
